dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple distinct 'O' shaped light-grey rings on a dark-grey ground. Three prominent rings on the posterior flank exhibit sharp high-contrast outer perimeters with a gradual gradient transition to darker interiors. Additional semi-closed 'C' shapes are visible along the mid-dorsal line.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, irregular light-colored pixel clusters located primarily on the lower ventral-lateral region. These clusters lack internal gradients and are most concentrated in the area between the shoulder and the mid-section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A clear triangular geometric relationship is formed by the centroids of the three most prominent circular annuli on the posterior flank. A roughly linear alignment of four smaller blobs is observed extending from the mid-torso toward the front flipper.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, diffuse, irregularly shaped light-grey patch is visible on the upper shoulder area, distinct from the smaller circular annuli due to its larger surface area and less defined perimeter geometry.
